## Goal
Finish final-regression failure classification, retry cap, issue-log recording, and next-action behavior without returning failures to the normal review/gate loop.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Second final-regression failure writes previousFailureKind and nextAction stop.
- Failure classification writes only final-regression artifacts and issue-log entries.
- get-next-action exposes final-regression after retro and before finalize with the expected schema.
